info.name: VoteChain API
info.description:
Importable Postman collection for the VoteChain public API.

Generated from `api/openapi.yml` (OpenAPI 3.1.0) — VoteChain API v1.0.0. The collection is version-pinned to that spec version; regenerate it whenever the spec changes.

## Setup

1. Import this file into Postman (File → Import).
2. Adjust the `baseUrl` and `indexerUrl` collection variables for your environment (defaults: `http://localhost:3001` and `http://localhost:3000`).
3. Adjust `proposalId` and `voterAddress` to real values before sending indexer requests.

## Notes

- Read-only (`GET`) endpoints require no authentication in the current release.
- `POST /api/proposals/invalidate` is intended for internal use by the event indexer and should be restricted at the network/proxy layer. A future release may require an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on mutating endpoints — this collection ships a disabled `Authorization` header on that request for that case.

item.name: Proposals (backend)
item.description: Governance proposal endpoints served by the Node.js backend (`/api/proposals`).

query.description: Last seen proposal ID (exclusive). Omit to fetch the first page. Pass the `next_cursor` value from the previous response to advance.
Maximum number of proposals to return. Default 20, capped at 100.
Filter proposals by lifecycle state: active, passed, rejected, executed, cancelled.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of governance proposals. Results are cached for 30 seconds in Redis; the `X-Cache` response header is `HIT` or `MISS`.
Returns full details for a single governance proposal, including vote tallies. Response is cached for 10 seconds in Redis; the `X-Cache` response header is `HIT` or `MISS`.

header.description: Not required in the current release. Present (disabled) for the planned `Authorization: Bearer <token>` requirement on mutating endpoints.

request.description:
Instructs the backend to evict stale proposal data from Redis. Without a body (or with `id` omitted) it clears the proposal list cache entry; with `id` it clears both the list cache and the specific item cache.

Access control: this endpoint should be reachable only from internal services (e.g. the event indexer). Restrict access at the network or proxy layer.

item.name: Metrics (backend)
item.description: Internal observability endpoints served by the Node.js backend.

request.description: Returns in-memory hit/miss counters for the Redis proposal cache. Counters are reset when the process restarts.

item.name: Indexer
item.description: Endpoints served by the Rust event indexer. Point `indexerUrl` at the indexer process (default `http://localhost:3000`).

query.description: Filter proposals by lifecycle state: active, passed, rejected, executed, cancelled.

request.description: Returns a page of proposals sourced from the indexer database.
Returns full proposal detail from the indexer database.
Returns all vote records for the given proposal.
Returns all votes cast by a given Stellar address (G... format).

variable.description: Base URL of the Node.js backend.
Base URL of the Rust event indexer.
Numeric proposal ID used in path parameters.
Stellar account address (G... format) used in indexer path parameters.
Optional Bearer token for future authenticated mutating endpoints.
